content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Sells ad verification and measurement software to advertisers; it does not own consumer lifestyle media or sell affiliate-driven content."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Radio broadcasting and podcast audio with FCC licensing differ from owning digital lifestyle publications and affiliate commerce."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Local newspapers and commercial printing serve local businesses, unlike national digital lifestyle brands with affiliate commerce."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"News, books and property listing portals differ from the lifestyle, food, health and personal finance brands with affiliate commerce."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"A marketing agency network that earns fees on client budgets, not a publisher owning consumer media brands."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Native ad technology placing sponsored links on third-party publisher sites differs from owning and operating its own consumer brands."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Owns sports, lifestyle and finance media brands earning ads, sponsored content and affiliate commissions from shared audiences, like the target."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Travel review and booking platform monetized by hotel bookings and travel advertising, a different consumer market from lifestyle media."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Radio stations and cable television selling airtime to advertisers differ from digital publications and affiliate commerce."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Programmatic ad buying software charging fees on ad spend, not owning consumer content brands that sell audiences."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Owns digital consumer media brands including health, earning ads and affiliate commissions from reviews, closely matching the target's model."}]}
